A '''Carosite smuggler''' was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to affect the [[Carosite]]'s mind and forge [[Gender/Legends|him]] into a atavistic creature ruled by impulses of terror. The former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] then was made into a loyal guard for Vader and stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], two [[operative]]s affiliated with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], had an encounter with the beast in the catacombs of Belsavis.
